messages.author: 7e471a974e0833d4
messages.subject: Basic qplot question
parts:
Just starting to learn and confused. I have a data frame that is about
6900 rows in length. I try to do a simple qplot. The graph comes up
with the axis but without any actual data. Also the x axis (Dates)
shows up as two gray lines with no text. Here's the data and
statement I'm using:

head(x, 10)
Date ratio
1 1983-03-30 0.8947821
2 1983-03-31 0.8892273
3 1983-04-04 0.8831042
4 1983-04-05 0.8897646
5 1983-04-06 0.8946374
6 1983-04-07 0.9066406
7 1983-04-08 0.9163370
8 1983-04-11 0.9038753
9 1983-04-12 0.9201951
10 1983-04-13 0.9195299

qplot(Date, ratio, data=x, geom="line")

Another odd thing I've noticed is that if I leave the geom="line"
statement out of the qplot statement, the data shows up (but I still
get two gray lines and no text for the x axis.

What am I doing wrong here ?

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: Basic qplot question
parts:
> Another odd thing I've noticed is that if I leave the geom="line"
> statement out of the qplot statement, the data shows up (but I still
> get two gray lines and no text for the x axis.
>
> What am I doing wrong here ?

You don't provide quite enough information to know for sure (dput from
your data frame would really help), but my guess is that you haven't
converted your date strings into dates. The easiest way to do that is
with the lubridate package:

library(lubridate)
x$Date <- ymd(x$Date)

Hadley
